title: Zoe placeholder
description: A plain stand-in for media: a warm cream-to-grey wash for photos, a faint ink tint for product shots on cream cards, a navy surface, a pale glass panel for composites on yellow, or a flat yellow. Can fade in as it enters view, like the site's lazily loaded pictures.
notes: decorative and aria-hidden: never draws the subject it replaces
size, aspect ratio and radius come from className
fade uses a CSS view timeline; without support (or with reduced motion) it simply shows
